Brandon Miller scored the Hornets' first basket more than anyone in 2025-26: 25 times in 67 starts, or 37% of the games they started. LaMelo Ball was next with 17. The Hornets made the game's first field goal in 51% of their 84 games and won 41% of their opening tipoffs. Everything below is counted from the play-by-play of every 2025-26 game (1,225 regular season, 85 playoffs, 6 play-in).
